therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: mTOR inhibition combined with androgen receptor antagonism
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: inhibition of tumor cell proliferation and survival pathways in androgen-independent prostate cancer
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: patients with androgen independent prostate cancer
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: overall response rate (PSA decline, measurable disease response, or stable disease ≥6 months)

safety_signals: serious adverse events including anemia, mucositis, fatigue, infection

context.duration: approximately 1 year follow-up, median time to progression 8.7 weeks
